//: Loaded by 'dotnet run -- --variant real'. Repoints ADP at its real endpoints and keeps the mTLS connection the vendor requires. Nothing sensitive is committed here and NO placeholder keys are declared: this file only overrides the endpoint facts, so values you export as environment variables (CredProx__Credentials__adp__ClientId, CredProx__Secrets__adpClientSecret, CredProx__Secrets__adpClientCert), set as user-secrets, or serve from Key Vault ('--variant kv') reach the app untouched. adpClientCert is the base64 passwordless PFX exactly as the adp-auth-cert vault secret stores it.
